Skill.constraints[0]: Call index.search exactly once, using request.term unchanged as its query argument.
Skill.constraints[1]: When from_date is present, pass its value unchanged; the accepted format is YYYY-MM-DD.
Skill.constraints[2]: When from_date is missing, omit the from_date argument.
Skill.constraints[3]: When limit is present, pass its value unchanged as the limit argument.
Skill.constraints[4]: When limit is missing, omit the limit argument.
Skill.constraints[5]: Do not invoke index.delete anywhere in this workflow.
Skill.constraints[6]: Parameter descriptions are call requirements and do not instruct pre-call validation or normalization.
Skill.constraints[7]: index.search supports fuzzy matching; this note does not request fuzzy expansion in this workflow.
Skill.constraints[8]: After the search, write the response's total value to local count.txt.
Skill.constraints[9]: Return the search response's items value unchanged.
